stories.headline: Democrats plan AI safety and data-center bills
stories.summary: Democrats plan bills on AI testing, liability and data-center electricity costs when they take control of Congress in January. These are proposals, not enacted rules, and face presidential opposition.

stories.headline: Tech stocks attempt rebound after AI-led selloff
stories.summary: Nasdaq futures rose early Friday after Thursday's sharp technology selloff put the Nasdaq in correction territory. Concerns include AI spending returns and future regulation. Premarket gains do not predict the closing result.

stories.headline: Fed's Williams says inflation remains too high
stories.summary: John Williams says growth and employment remain resilient but inflation must return sustainably to 2%. He did not specify the Fed's next rate decision; market expectations are not policy commitments.

stories.headline: Iran sends nuclear proposal through Qatar
stories.summary: A senior Iranian official says Tehran sent a nuclear proposal via Qatar, conditional on Washington meeting seven demands. Reuters attributes the account to that official; it does not establish an agreement or reopening of Hormuz.

stories.headline: Ukraine seeks explicit postwar security guarantees
stories.summary: Zelenskyy wants written clarity on who would respond to another Russian attack, and how. Allied discussions continue ahead of planned trilateral talks, while attacks persist. No settlement or binding guarantee has been announced.
